questions.question:
The given pie-chart represents the percentage of students enrolled in five different sports. The total number of students is 2800.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f5f58484665c9c97b1464092d4e7ff3914356a8fc6864ddd0ec30d4b34a7a80.png] 

If 24 students playing cricket are shifted to Kabaddi, then find the new ratio of the number of students in Cricket to those in Kabaddi.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

⇒ Number of cricket playing student = 23% of 2800 = 644 

⇒ Number of Kabaddi playing student = 12% of 2800 = 336 

**Calculation:**

⇒ Number of cricket playing student after 24 student remove = 620 

⇒ Number of kabaddi player after 24 student added = 360

⇒ New ratio of the number of students in Cricket and Kabaddi playing student = 620 : 360 = 31 : 18 

**∴ The required ratio is ** **31 : 18 .**

questions.question: If x³ + y³ = 16 and x + y = 4, then the value of x⁴ + y⁴ is:
questions.solution:
**Given **

x3 + y3 = 16

x + y = 4

**Formula Used **

x3 + y3 = (x + y) (x2 – xy + y2)

x4 + y4 = (x2 + y2)2 - 2x2y2

**Calculation **

⇒ x³ + y³ = (x + y) (x² – xy + y²)

⇒ Putting given values of x³ + y³ and (x + y)

⇒ 16 = 4 × ((x+y)² – 3xy)

⇒ 16 = 4 × (16 – 3xy)

⇒ 16 = 64 – 12xy

⇒ 12xy = 48

⇒ xy = 4

⇒ x⁴ + y⁴ = (x² + y²)² - 2x²y²

⇒ (x² + y²)² – 2 × 16

⇒ ((x + y)² – 2xy)² – 2 × 16

⇒ (16 – 8)² – 2 × 16

⇒ 64 - 32 = 32

∴ x⁴ + y⁴ is 32.

questions.question: A is a point at a distance 26 cm from the centre O of a circle of radius 10 cm. AP and AQ are the tangents to the circle at the point of contacts P and Q. If a tangent BC is drawn at a point R lying on the minor arc PQ to intersect AP at B and AQ at C, then the perimeter of ΔABC is:
questions.solution:
**Given **

Radius of circle = 10 cm 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9924ea825b42d649def31122dd7ecd01a4a02defdb9380085ed9570a0122a9ac.png] 

**Formula Used **

(Hypotnuese)² = (perpendicular)² + (Base)²

**Calculation **

⇒ BP = BR and CR = CQ** **

⇒Perimeter of ΔABC = AB + BR + RC + CA

and

BP = BR and RC = CQ [equal tangent theorem]

**Equal Tangent Theorem: This theorem states that if from one external point, two tangents are drawn to a circle then they have equal tangent segments. **

So

⇒ AB + BP + QC + CA

= AP + QA (AP = QA, From equal tangent theorem) 

⇒2AP

⇒ In ΔAPO

⇒AO²=AP²+PO²

⇒26² = AP² + 10²

⇒ AP² = 576

⇒ AP = 24

⇒ The perimeter of the ΔABC = 2 x 24 = 48** **cm

questions.question: Evaluate: [7 + 7 × ( 7 + 7 ÷ 7)] + 7 ÷ 7.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

 [7 + 7 × ( 7 + 7 ÷ 7)] + 7 ÷ 7. 

**Concept used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c49e9ef184ad3a244b4a0e325f1c03fdf73a234e5d04e86e969336de19771c93.png] 

**Calculation:**

⇒ [7 + 7 × ( 7 + 7 ÷ 7)] + 7 ÷ 7.

⇒ [7 + 7 × (7 + 1)] + 1

⇒ 63 + 1 = 64

questions.question: ABC and BDE are two equilateral triangles such that D is the mid-point of BC. If the area of triangle ABC is 136 cm², then the area of triangle BDE is equal to:
questions.solution:
**Given **

Area of ΔABC = 136 cm²

**Formula Used ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b9509aaa48d5b114dda525824dbfb8386316754cc2343dd4730556bfe64adc1b.png] 

Area of equilateral triangle = √3(a²/4) , where a is the side of the triangle.

**Calculation**

If each side of ΔABC = 2x unit

Then, Area of ΔABC = √3 x² ---- (1)

Now, BD = BC/2 ( given)

⇒ BD = 2x/2 = x

So, area of equilateral triangle BDE =√3x²/4 ---- (2)

⇒ By dividing (1) by (2)

⇒ ar(ΔABC)/ar(ΔBDE) = (√3x²)/(√3x²/4) = 4/1

⇒ 4 : 1 

⇒ Area of ΔABC = 136 

⇒ 4x = 136 

⇒ x = 34 

**∴ The area of ΔBDE is 34 cm²**

questions.question: If Cos 3θ = Sin (θ - 34°), then the value of θ as an acute angle is:
questions.solution:
**Given **

Cos 3θ = Sin (θ - 34°)

**Formula used **

sin (90° - θ) = cos θ

**Calculation **

⇒ sin (90 -3θ) = sin {(θ - 34)}

⇒ 90° - 3θ = θ - 34° 

⇒ θ = 31° 

**∴ θ = 31° **

questions.question: Rahul and Mithun travel a distance of 30 km. The sum of their speeds is 70 km/h and the total time taken by both to travel the distance is 2 hours 6 minutes. The difference between their speeds is:
questions.solution:
**Given **

 Rahul and Mithun travel = 30 km 

Sum of their speed = 70 km/h

**Formula used **

Distance = speed × time 

**Calculation **

let the speed of rahul = s 

⇒ speed of mithun = 70 - s 

⇒ total time = 2(6/60) hr = 21/10 hr 

⇒ 30/s + {30/(70 - s)} = 21/10 

⇒ s² - 70s + 1000 = 0

⇒ s² - 50s - 20s + 1000 = 0 

⇒ s(s - 50) - 20(s - 50) = 0 

⇒ (s - 50) (s - 20) = 0 

⇒ s = 50 km/hr , s = 20 km/hr 

when speed of Rahul = 50 km/hr , speed of mithun = 20 km/hr 

when speed of mithun = 50 km/hr , speed of rahul = 20 km.hr 

**∴ The difference of their speed is 30 km/hr **

questions.question:
Study the given bar chart and answer the question that follows.

Production of Fertilizers by a Company (in 10,000 tonnes) Over the Years

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/182d7c383c71d3e19f98eb20e904d066f9ced6346fe26854d6098c7176b93318.png] 

What was the approximate percentage increase in the production of fertilizers from 1998 to 1999 ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The production of fertilizers in 1998 = 45 tonnes 

The production of fertilizers in 1999 = 65 tonnes 

**Concept used:**

Percentage = (actual value)/(comparison value) × 100 

**Calculation:**

Increase in the production of fertilizers from 1998 to 1999 = 20

Percentage increase in the production of fertilizers from 1998 to 1999 = (20/45) × 100 = 44.4% 

**∴ The percentage increase in the production of fertilizers from 1998 to 1999 is 44.4% **

questions.question: If √3cosθ = sinθ, then the value of (4sin² theta - 5 cos theta)/(3 cos theta + 1) is
questions.solution:
**Given:**

√3cosθ = sinθ

**calculation:**

⇒ sinθ/cosθ = √3

⇒ tanθ = √3

⇒ θ = 60° 

Then, (4sin² θ - 5 cos θ)/(3 cos θ + 1) = [4(√3/2)² - (5/2)]/[(3/2) + 1] 

⇒ (1/2)/(5/2) = 1/5 

**∴ The required value is 1/5.**

questions.question: In an isosceles triangle ABC with AB = AC and AD is perpendicular to BC, if AD = 6 cm and the perimeter of ΔABC is 36 cm, then the area of ΔABC is:
questions.solution:
**Given **

Δ ABC is an isosceles triangle , AB = AC 

Ad = 6 cm 

**Formula used **

Area of triangle = 1/2 × base × height 

**Figure:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/daf768c3c6110d7d2a6c18aa7f6820156caa0c05301f0fafa045457fd6e5efda.png] 

**Calculation:**

Let, Base = b, and two equal sides = a 

According to the given data,

⇒ 2a + b = 36 ---(1)

⇒ 2a = 36 - b

⇒ a = (36 - b)/2 ---(2)

Now, AD perpendicular to BC ,so ΔADB is a right angle triangle.

So, AB² = AD² + BD²

⇒ a² = 6² + (b/2)²

⇒ a2 = 36 + b²/4

⇒ a2 - b2/4 = 36 

⇒ 4a2 - b2 = 36 × 4

⇒ (2a + b) (2a - b) = 144

Putting the value of (2a + b) from equation (1),

⇒ 36 × (2a - b) = 144

⇒ 2a - b = 4

Putting the value of b from equation (2),

⇒ 2 × (36 - b)/2 - b = 4

⇒ (36 - b) - b = 4

⇒ 36 - 2b = 4

⇒ 2b = 36 - 4 

⇒ b = 32/2 = 16 cm

So, the area of the Δ ABC = 1/2 × 16 × 6 = 48 cm²

∴ Area of triangle ABC is 48 cm2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

AD perpendicular to BC ,so ΔADB is a right angle triangle

We know the triplet (6,8,10) 

so AB= 10 , AD = 6 cm and BD = 8 cm 

BC = 2 × BD (In isosceles triangle, altitude and median are same)

BC = 16 cm 

Area of triangle ABC = 1/2 × 16 × 6 = 48 cm²

**∴ Area of triangle ABC is 48 cm2**

questions.question: An article was sold at a loss of 12%. If it was sold for Rs. 630 more, then there would have been a gain of 6%. Find the cost price of the article.
questions.solution:
**Formula used **

Cost price = (selling price)/(100 + profit%) × 100

**Calculation **

Let the cost price of article 100x 

Sell at 12% loss = 88x 

Sell at 6% gain = 106x 

106x - 88x = 630 

⇒ x = 630/18 = 35 

⇒ 100x = 100 × 35 = 3500 

**∴ The cost price of article is Rs 3500**

questions.question: If the difference between the compound interest and simple interest on a certain sum of money for three years at 10% p.a. is Rs. 558, then the sum is:
questions.solution:
**Given **

The difference in compound interest and simple interest for 3 years = Rs 558

Rate of interest = 10% 

**Formula Used **

Simple interest = principal × rate × time/100

Compound interest = p[(1 + r/100)t - 1]

**Calculation **

Let the principal be p

558 = p[(1 + 10/100)³ - 1] - 3p/10

⇒ 558 = p[331/1000 - 3/10]

⇒ p = 558 × (1000/31) = 18000 

**∴ The sum is Rs 18000**

questions.question: The salaries of Vipin and Dinesh are in the ratio 5 : 8. If the salary of each is increased by Rs. 4,800. then new ratio becomes 7 : 10. What is Vipin’s salary ?
questions.solution:

The salary of each increased = Rs 4800 

**Calculation **

let the salary of vipin and Dinesh be 5x and 8x

(5x + 4800)/(8x + 4800) = 7/10 

⇒ 50x + 48000 = 56x + 33600 

⇒ x = 14400/6 = 2400 

Vipin salary = 5x = 5 × 2400 = Rs 12000

questions.question: If 4M37094267N is divisible by both 8 and 11, where M and N are single digit integers, then the values of M and N are:
questions.solution:
**Given **

The number which is divisible by 8 and 11 = 4M37094267N

**Concept Used **

divisibility rule of 8 - if the last 3 digit of any number is divisible by 8, then the whole number divisible by 8 

divisibility rule of 11 - the sum of odd place digits - the sum of even place digits = 0 or 11 

**Calculation **

67N last 3 digits of the number 

According to the rule of divisibility by 8, N should be 2 

So, the value of N = 2 

Now no. = 4M370942672

⇒ the sum of odd place digit - the sum of even digit place = 0 OR 11

⇒ (4 + 3 + 0 + 4 + 6+ 2) - (M + 7 + 9 + 2 + 7) = 11

⇒ M = 5

**∴ The value of M = 5 and N = 2**

questions.question: The average of nine 2 digit numbers is decreased by 6 when the digits of one of the 2 digit numbers is interchanged. Find the difference between the digits of that number.
questions.solution:
**Given **

The average of nine 2 digit number decreases by = 6

**Formula Used **

Average = Sum of Observation/ No. of Observation

**Calculation**

Let the number be 10x+y

(Sum of eight numbers + 10x + y)/9 - 6 = (Sum of eight numbers + 10y + x)/9

⇒ (Sum of eight numbers + 10x + y) - 54 = (Sum of eight numbers + 10y + x)

⇒ 10x + y - 54 = 10y + x

⇒ 9x - 9y = 54

⇒ x - y = 6

**∴ The difference between the digit of number is 6.**

questions.question: The difference of two positive numbers is 1020. If 7.6% of the greater number is 12.4% of the smaller number, then the sum of the two numbers is equal to:
questions.solution:
**Given **

the difference of 2 positive number = 1020 

**Calculation**

⇒ Let two numbers be x and y resp.

⇒ 7.6% of x = 12.4% of y 

⇒ x : y = 31 : 19 

⇒ x - y = 1020 

⇒ 31a - 19a = 1020 

⇒ a = 1020/12 = 85 

⇒ sum of two numbers = 31a + 19a = 50a 

⇒ 50 × 85 = 4250

**∴ The sum of two numbers is 4250**

questions.question: ABC is a right angled triangle, right angled at A. A circle is inscribed in it. The lengths of two sides containing the right angle are 48 cm and 14 cm. The radius of the inscribed circle is:
questions.solution:
**Given **

AB = 48 cm 

AC = 14 cm

**Figure:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/90172da76299a97d1b8ca019cb895ac520015f1d3cd9ca95590ac46ac294e786.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a66516067bf33323d142498572eb259f85cfc3dc327934926d82a3d4e01cf7e.png] 

**Formula used **

(Hypotnuese)² = Perpendicular²+ base²

Area of triangle = 1/2 × Base × Height 

**Calculation **

Let OP = OQ = OR = radius = r cm 

BC² = AB² +AC²

⇒ BC = √(48² + 14²) = 50 cm 

Area of Δ ABC = area of Δ OAB + area of Δ OBC + area of Δ OAC 

⇒ 1/2 × 48 × 14 = 1/2 × [48r + 14r + 50r]

⇒ r = 48 × 14/(112) = 6 cm 

**∴ The radius of incircle is 6 cm **

questions.question: If 3.96 cubic dm of lead is to be drawn in to a cylindrical wire of diameter 0.6 cm, then the length of the wire (in metres), is:
questions.solution:
**Given **

Diameter of cylindrical wire = .6cm 

**Formula Used **

Volume of cylinder = πR²H

**Calculation **

1 dm = 10 cm 

1 dm³ = 1000 cm³

So, 3.96 dm³ = 3960 cm³

Volume of the cylinder = πR²l

3960 = (22/7) × (.6/2)² × l 

⇒ l = 14000 cm 

⇒ 1m = 100cm 

⇒14000 cm = 140 m 

**∴ The length of cylindrical wire is 140 m
**

questions.question: If xsin³θ + ycos³θ = sinθ cosθ and xsinθ = ycosθ, then the value of x² + y² is:
questions.solution:
**Given **

xsin3θ + ycos3θ = sinθ cosθ

xsinθ = ycosθ

**Formula used **

sin²θ + cos²θ = 1

**Calculation **

x sin³ θ + y cos³ θ = sin θ cos θ

⇒ (x sin θ) sin² θ + (y cos θ) cos² θ = sin θ cos θ

⇒ (x sin θ) sin² θ + (x sin θ) cos² θ = sin θ cos θ ( y cos θ = x sin θ)

⇒ x sin θ(sin² θ + cos² θ) = sin θ cos θ

⇒ x sin θ = sin θ cos θ

⇒ x = cos θ ----(1)

Again x sin θ = y cos θ

⇒ cos θ sin θ = y cos θ

⇒ y = sin θ ----(2)

from (1) and (2)

⇒ x² + y² = sin2θ + cos2θ = 1

questions.question: A and B together can complete a piece of work in 15 days. B and C together can do it in 24 days. If A is twice as good a workman as C, then in how many days can B alone complete the work ?
questions.solution:
**Given **

A and B together can complete work = 15 days 

B and C together can complete work = 24 days 

**Formula Used **

Work = time × efficiency 

**Calculation **

Take LCM of (15, 24) = 120 

Let the total work be 120 

Efficiency of A and B = 120/15 = 8 ----(1)

Efficiency of B and C = 120/24 = 5 ----(2)

We know , A : C = 2 : 1 ----(3) 

From (1) and (2) 

⇒ A - C = 3 

By using (3) , efficiency of A = 6 , B = 2 and C = 3

⇒ B alone can complete the work in days = 120/2 = 60 days 

**∴ B alone can complete the work in days is 60 days **
